Exercise five. You have been issued an identification kit. Press 1 to hold up the magnifying glass, and look at the local wildlife through it until each one is named. First, identify five of the plant named in your objectives. Other plants do not count, however much you like them. Should the wildlife be up a slope, hold Space to help you climb. Some slopes are too steep to climb at all, and you are reminded that broken legs from falling down mountains are not covered by your Xenocorp health insurance.
